Screen Guide

Mythology in Film, TV & Games

A curated guide to productions that borrow names, stories, and imagery from the mythological traditions restored across PuniCodex.

All productions

40 film, series, animation, and game entries linked to restored names.

Clash of the Titans

Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer / United Artists

Ray Harryhausen's stop-motion epic follows Perseus as he faces the Kraken and challenges the gods of Olympus.

Film 1981 Greek

Big Trouble in Little China

20th Century Fox

A cult action-fantasy steeped in Chinese mythic imagery, sorcery, and the storm powers of Lo Pan's court.

Film 1986 Chinese

Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama

Nippon Ramayana Film Co. / Pentamedia Graphics

An Indo-Japanese animated retelling of the Sanskrit epic, following Rama's exile, Sita's abduction, and the war with Ravana.

Animation 1993 Sanskrit

Hercules

Walt Disney Pictures

Disney's animated musical recasts Herakles as a hero who must reclaim his godhood and rescue Mount Olympus from Hades.

Animation 1997 Greek

Princess Mononoke

Studio Ghibli

Miyazaki's film draws on Shinto and Japanese folk kami in its conflict between forest spirits and an industrializing human settlement.

Animation 1997 Japanese

Stargate SG-1

MGM Television

The long-running military-science-fiction series recasts Egyptian gods as parasitic Goa'uld who once posed as divine pharaohs.

Series 1997 Egyptian

Mulan

Walt Disney Pictures

Disney's animated adaptation of the Chinese ballad emphasizes ancestor veneration and dragon iconography.

Animation 1998 Chinese

The Mummy

Universal Pictures

A swashbuckling horror-adventure revolving around Imhotep's curse, with heavy Egyptian funerary and deity imagery.

Film 1999 Egyptian

O Brother, Where Art Thou?

Touchstone Pictures / Universal Pictures

The Coen brothers' Depression-era comedy loosely adapts the Odyssey, with Everett standing in for Odysseus and Penny for Penelope.

Film 2000 Greek

The Road to El Dorado

DreamWorks Animation

Two con artists are mistaken for gods in a Mesoamerican-inspired city of gold, borrowing Aztec and Maya visual motifs.

Animation 2000 Nahuatl

Spirited Away

Studio Ghibli

A girl enters a bathhouse for spirits populated by kami, yokai, and figures rooted in Japanese folk and Buddhist lore.

Animation 2001 Japanese

Naruto

Pierrot

The ninja anime names several powerful techniques after the Shinto creator pair and the three noble children of Izanagi and Izanami.

Series 2002 Japanese

Troy

Warner Bros. Pictures

A Bronze-age war epic based on the Iliad, dramatizing the siege through its kings, warriors, and divine prophecies.

Film 2004 Greek

Apocalypto

Touchstone Pictures / Icon Productions

Mel Gibson's survival thriller set in the late Maya period, saturated with Mesoamerican temple ritual and solar imagery.

Film 2006 Nahuatl

Kung Fu Panda

DreamWorks Animation

A wuxia comedy about a panda chosen as the Dragon Warrior, weaving Chinese martial-arts tropes with mythic dragon symbolism.

Animation 2008 Chinese

Clash of the Titans

Warner Bros. Pictures / Legendary Pictures

A remake in which Perseus battles the Kraken and the underworld while Olympus argues over the fate of mortals.

Film 2010 Greek

Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief

20th Century Fox

A modern demigod discovers he is Poseidon's son and is drawn into a conflict among the Olympian gods.

Film 2010 Greek

Thor

Marvel Studios

The Marvel Cinematic Universe introduces the Norse thunder god and his exile to Earth after defying Odin.

Film 2011 Norse

Immortals

Relativity Media

A stylized Greek-myth action film pitting Theseus and the gods against the ruthless Titan-aligned king Hyperion.

Film 2011 Greek

Thor: The Dark World

Marvel Studios

Thor and Loki reluctantly team up to stop the Dark Elf Malekith from plunging the Nine Realms into darkness.

Film 2013 Norse

Vikings

History Channel / MGM Television

A historical drama centered on Ragnar Lothbrok and his sons, with frequent visions of Odin, Valhalla, and Ragnarok.

Series 2013 Norse

Smite

Hi-Rez Studios

A third-person MOBA that pits gods and mythological figures from multiple pantheons against one another.

Game 2014 GreekNorseEgyptianSanskrit

Fate/Grand Order

Lasengle / Aniplex

A mobile gacha RPG that summons heroic and divine spirits from world history and mythology as Servants.

Game 2015 MesopotamianGreek

Gods of Egypt

Summit Entertainment / Lionsgate

A fantasy action film depicting the conflict between Horus and Set for the throne of Egypt, with Ra's solar barge at stake.

Film 2016 Egyptian

Thor: Ragnarok

Marvel Studios

A comedic cosmic adventure that brings Ragnarok, Surtur, Hela, and the destruction of Asgard into the MCU.

Film 2017 Norse

Wonder Woman

DC Films / Warner Bros. Pictures

Diana of Themyscira enters the Great War, drawing on Amazonian and Olympian backstory tied to Zeus and Ares.

Film 2017 Greek

American Gods

Fremantle / Starz

Neil Gaiman's adaptation brings old gods to modern America, prominently featuring Odin, Anubis, and the Slavic black god.

Series 2017 NorseEgyptianSlavic

The Lighthouse

A24

A psychological horror film soaked in maritime myth, with Prometheus imagery of fire, punishment, and defiance of the gods.

Film 2019 Greek

Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice

FromSoftware

A Japanese action game set in the Sengoku period, drawing on Buddhist wrathful deities, immortality quests, and Shinto dragon imagery.

Game 2019 Japanese

Mulan

Walt Disney Pictures

A live-action retelling of the Chinese legend, with phoenix symbolism and ancestor-veneration themes.

Film 2020 Chinese

Hades

Supergiant Games

A roguelike action game in which Zagreus attempts to escape the Underworld, encountering most of the Olympian pantheon.

Game 2020 Greek

Final Fantasy VII Remake

Square Enix

The remake reintroduces the series' signature summon materia, including Shiva, Ifrit, and Leviathan.

Game 2020 SanskritCanaanite

Ghost of Tsushima

Sucker Punch Productions

An open-world samurai game set during the Mongol invasion, dotted with Shinto shrines, foxes, and kami of wind and thunder.

Game 2020 Japanese

Graphinica / Warner Bros. Japan

A tournament anime pits humanity's greatest fighters against gods from many pantheons to decide mankind's survival.

Marvel Studios

The Northman

A Norse revenge saga directed by Robert Eggers, steeped in Odinic prophecy, Valhalla, and Viking ritual.

Film 2022 Norse

Marvel Studios

The sequel introduces Talokan, a Mesoamerican-inspired underwater civilization whose visual language draws on Aztec and Maya deities.

Film 2022 Nahuatl

Santa Monica Studio

Kratos and Atreus journey through the Nine Realms during Fimbulwinter, confronting figures from Norse apocalyptic myth.

Game 2022 Norse
